title: Search a 2D Matrix
description: You are given an m x n integer matrix where each row is sorted in non-decreasing order and the first integer of each row is greater than the last integer of the previous row. Given an integer target, return true if target is in the matrix. You must write an algorithm with O(log(m * n)) runtime complexity.
